newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Poisoning suspected in deaths of Bangladesh tigers.
newsitem.headline: Poisoning suspected in deaths of Bangladesh tigers.

text.p: Three rare Bengal tigers have died in as many days at Bangladesh's national zoo and officials said on Tuesday they suspected the animals were poisoned.
"We are suspecting this is a case of poisoning. We are investigating it," a senior official with the government's directorate of livestocks, which manages the zoo in Dhaka, told Reuters.
The corpses have been sent to a laboratory for post mortem and chemical tests, he said.
One tiger died on Saturday and two others on Monday. "They passed away in short time after developing sickness," one zoo official said.
"Vigilance in the zoo has been tightened following the deaths," he said without elaborating.
The Dhaka zoo has 17 Bengal tigers left, including three cubs.
